title: Count Non Adjacent Subsets in a Rooted Tree
summary: Given a rooted tree with nodes labeled from 0 to n-1, where node 0 is the root, and an integer array nums with values for each node, find the count of non-empty subsets of nodes whose values sum to a multiple of k, ensuring no two nodes in the subset are adjacent, modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Given a rooted tree with nodes labeled from 0 to n-1, where node 0 is the root, and an integer array nums with values for each node, find the count of non-empty subsets of nodes whose values sum to a multiple of k, ensuring no two nodes in the subset are adjacent, modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: parent[0] is -1 and parent[i] < i for every other node.
Choose a nonempty independent set: no selected node may have its parent selected.
Count selections whose value sum is divisible by k, modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: For each subtree, separate counts where its root is skipped from counts where it is selected.
Store each state by its sum remainder modulo k.
A skipped parent may combine with either child state; a selected parent may combine only with a skipped child.
Convolve remainder arrays child by child, then add both root states at remainder zero and remove the empty selection.
editorial: Convolve remainder arrays child by child, then add both root states at remainder zero and remove the empty selection.
